scientific_integrity: A self-contained smooth-lifting proof treats all residue sizes and lengths; exact finite enumerations verify four full small-ring cases and five selected targets over a nonreduced four-element-residue ring. No external independence or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two-by-two determinant-one matrices over finite commutative chain rings with ring characteristic two only. Nonprimitive full-rank-leading fibers are bounded but not completely evaluated. Complete historical priority is not established; independent review is not performed.
title: Sharp two-sum special-linear minorization over characteristic-two chain rings
